name: Jack and the Temple of Shadows
description: Jack and The Temple of Shadows is an educational game designed to help English learners master prepositions of time and place. Through an engaging adventure story, players join Jack as he explores a mysterious temple, solving preposition puzzles to progress. The game covers three essential prepositions: AT, IN, and ON, with 12 immersive jungle scenes and 100 engaging gaps. Perfect for ESL students aged 8 and up.
